description: Label data for machine learning in Label Studio: create projects, import tasks, add annotations and model predictions, and export labels. Start a workflow when a task is annotated or labelled, or a project is finished.

label_studio_project_finished_trigger.description: Runs when every task in a project is labelled, such as to export the labels and start training.
